items.abstract: <jats:p>A 22-week stillborn fetus with 47,XXX karyotype had lower mesodermal defects consisting of irregular fusion of the sacral vertebrae, anal agenesis, multicystic dysplasia of a horseshoe kidney, a single umbilical artery, dysplastic ovaries, and uterine hypoplasia. This case provides additional evidence for an association between trisomy X and genitourinary defects including lower mesodermal defects sequence.</jats:p>
title: Case Report of a 22-Week Fetus with 47,XXX Karyotype and Multiple Lower Mesodermal Defects
